summary: Authored a six-phase implementation plan for the formula-level Auxiliary-Atoms rule at FrameClass.ZTime, assembling the research report's compiled route into one new module FormalSystem/Metalogic/AuxiliaryAtoms.lean. The plan's ten Lean Challenge Statements were type-checked against the live library with lake env lean (exit 0, sorry warnings only), so every pinned signature is measured rather than asserted. Phases 1-5 are local-tier transcription-and-assembly on the single new module; Phase 6 is the full-tier headline, axiom-profile evidence pin, documentation reconciliation and repository gate set. suite_selection_select returns __FULL_SWEEP__ for every declared path, so each non-final phase's covering check is the scoped guarded module build.
